build._doc: No data_wrap step, unlike linktree_mindmap. This portal imports the linktree JSON directly in TypeScript (see modules/data-from-linktree.ts), so esbuild inlines it at build time — there is nothing to fetch at runtime and therefore no data-*.json.js companions to emit or copy.
Inject navigator.serviceWorker.register(...) before </head>. MUST run BEFORE esbuild_sw so the modified HTML feeds into BUILD_HASH.
Inject single-namespace observability SDK. Mirrors console.* + errors + SW lifecycle to OPFS console.log.
MUST run last — hashes the dist artifacts above to derive BUILD_HASH and inject it into the SW bundle.
